## Code Review

This pull request adds a validator plan, validator results, and an example template for the V1 Served-Subset Owner Decision process (issue #1130). These files establish validation rules and candidate rows for eight minimal trusted candidates, ensuring the placeholder template is validated but rejected as a final decision until completed by a human. I have no feedback to provide on these changes.
